cases.name: valid
cases.note: admitted; exact_call_binding projects NARROWED to remora.port_v0.bound_action

limits: establishes that the evidence verifies under the pinned REMORA key in REMORA/FEDERATION-ACTION/v1
does not establish semantic correctness of the authorization
does not establish execution, effect or complete mediation
does not establish full REMORA exact_call_binding-v1.1
does not establish principal binding
the tenant is a caller-supplied label, not an authenticated tenant
arguments are compared as JavaScript values, so 1 and 1.0 are not distinguished
does not establish effect
expiry is compared at admission on the runtime's local clock
does not establish revocation state, policy or ToolSpec freshness, or signing-key status
the V0 contract carries no authenticated principal
V0 adapters run in the runtime's own process
provider_confirmed is an execution report, never EFFECT_VERIFIED
